Players Committee card image of [[Aayla Secura (Holo AI) (Errata 2)]] (the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF; recorded with that printing, not as a separate version), game text: “Power +1 for each opponent's character here. When with two of your aliens (or clones), adds one battle destiny. May not be targeted by weapons unless each of your other aliens and clones present are 'hit.' Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/aaylasecura_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 3f533fb] (19 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
